task3_coordinator_hub_partitioned_store.description: Added optional partitioned_store parameter to AgentReporter and CoordinatorDashboard
task3_coordinator_hub_partitioned_store.details: Both classes now accept an optional PartitionedStore instance. When provided, the hub partition connection is used for agent_status and coordinator_instructions tables. Connection ownership is tracked via _owns_conn flag to prevent closing shared connections. Full backwards compatibility preserved - existing code with db_path only works unchanged.
changes: AgentReporter.__init__: added partitioned_store param, uses hub.conn when provided
AgentReporter.close: only closes connection if _owns_conn is True
CoordinatorDashboard.__init__: added partitioned_store param, uses hub.conn when provided
CoordinatorDashboard.close: only closes connection if _owns_conn is True

task4_help_protocol_partitioned_store.description: Added optional partitioned_store parameter to HelpProtocol
task4_help_protocol_partitioned_store.details: HelpProtocol now accepts an optional PartitionedStore instance. When provided, the findings partition connection is used for work_items, help_requests, team_capabilities, and team_status tables (per db_partition.py TABLE_TO_PARTITION mapping). Schema initialization is skipped when using partitioned store since PartitionedStore handles it. Connection ownership tracked via _owns_conn flag.
changes: HelpProtocol.__init__: added partitioned_store param, uses findings.conn when provided
HelpProtocol.close: only closes connection if _owns_conn is True

backwards_compatibility: Fully preserved. All changes are additive. When partitioned_store is None (default), behavior is identical to pre-migration code.
